skill.bridge_plain: Forma simples (-ㄴ/는다, -았/었다), baze ba diskursu indireta
skill.bridge_modal: Kapasidade, obrigasaun no lisensa (-(으)ㄹ 수 있다, -아/어야 하다, -아/어도 되다)

bridge_formal.title: Final formál ho respeitu
bridge_formal.concept: Iha ko'alia formál no iha servisu, tau -ㅂ니다 ba radikal verbu ka adjetivu ne'ebé remata ho vogál no -습니다 ba radikal ne'ebé remata ho konsoante. Perguntas remata ho -ㅂ니까 / -습니까.

bridge_plain.title: Forma simples
bridge_plain.concept: Estilu simples (hakerek) remata sentensa deklarativa ho -ㄴ다 / -는다 no sentensa pasadu ho -았다 / -었다. Forma sira ne'e mak baze ba diskursu indireta iha lisaun tuir mai.

bridge_adnominal.title: Deskreve naran
bridge_adnominal.concept: Verbu ka adjetivu bele deskreve naran: -(으)ㄴ ba adjetivu no asaun pasadu, -는 ba asaun agora, -(으)ㄹ ba asaun futuru ka planeadu; tau molok naran.

bridge_connect.title: Konektór báziku
bridge_connect.concept: Hatama klausula rua ho -아/어서 (razaun ka sekuénsia), -지만 (kontrastu), -(으)니까 (razaun), -(으)면 (se) no -(으)려고 (atu).

bridge_modal.title: Kapasidade, obrigasaun, lisensa
bridge_modal.concept: -(으)ㄹ 수 있다/없다 hatudu kapasidade ka posibilidade, -아/어야 하다 obrigasaun, no -아/어도 되다 lisensa.
